title: The Duel of the Terrible Inventors

collection.credit:
* V9 "Age of Terrible Ideas": event prose, material applications,
  trial and consequence branches by ChatGPT. Core requests for intense
  conflict, fights, false guilt, courts, imprisonment, reconciliation,
  and the sixteen specific bizarre materials by Lorsieab2.

items.text: They reconcile over a repair project, while still arguing about tools.
They remain enemies but agree never to become physical again.
A third inventor wins the contest while they are arguing.
A child gives each a trophy labeled 'MOST DRAMATIC ADULT.'
One says, 'I thought you hated me.' The other replies, 'I do. I also know you're brilliant.'
One invention wins clearly. The loser storms away.
Both fail. A child suggests a simpler design that works.
Both work, but one smells like cave guano.
The devices combine into something unexpectedly useful.
One apologizes for shoving; the other admits to provoking (subject.him/her).
Both apologize for the physical fight but refuse to forgive the insults.
One denies wrongdoing; the organizers cancel the competition.
An elder says, 'You are both too old to fight like children.' A child objects that children are better behaved.

question.name: Two inventors
question.text:
Two inventors, (Subject) and (Friend), have spent years claiming the other is a fraud. They each present a device made from {v9_materials} and {v9_materials.2}. The first promises to {keep a roof dry|make a garden thrive|produce a beautiful melody}. The second promises the same thing, 'BUT BETTER.'
When one prototype fails, the inventors begin shouting. A wooden measuring stick is snatched away, and they start shoving one another. Nearby adults separate them before anyone is seriously hurt.

choices.label: Judge the inventions under the same test.
Require apologies and a cooling-off period first.
